description: Champions work in isolation with no shared space to exchange knowledge or experiences.
Informal, occasional conversations happen between champions, but there's no dedicated community structure.
A basic community channel or recurring meeting exists, though participation is inconsistent.
An active community (regular meetings, chat channel, or forum) supports knowledge sharing, recognition, and mutual support among champions.
A thriving, well-facilitated community drives continuous collaboration, peer recognition, and cross-team learning, and is seen as a core pillar of the program.
